items.detail: Italian Bred, starring the incomparable Candice Guardino, is a vibrant, hilarious, and deeply relatable theatrical experience that has captivated audiences across the country. Drawing on her Italian-American roots, Guardino delivers a one-woman show that is both uproarious and heartwarming, blending sharp comedy, poignant storytelling, and a celebration of family and tradition. This performance transcends cultural boundaries, offering humor and insight that resonate with audiences from all walks of life, whether or not they share Italian heritage. Candice Guardino’s storytelling is grounded in personal experiences, exploring themes of family dynamics, generational differences, and the universal search for identity and belonging. With quick wit, charming humor, and heartfelt honesty, she invites the audience into her world, creating an intimate connection that feels both authentic and universally engaging. From playful observations about growing up Italian-American to reflections on love, loss, and resilience, Italian Bred captures the complexities and joys of life in a way that everyone can relate to. The show’s popularity has grown beyond live performances, reaching a global audience through streaming platforms. Italian Bred is available on Prime Video and Apple TV, allowing fans everywhere to experience Candice’s signature humor and storytelling from the comfort of home. This accessibility has expanded the show’s reach, making it a must-see for comedy lovers, theater enthusiasts, and anyone seeking a performance that blends laughter with emotional depth. Critics and audiences alike have praised Italian Bred for its energetic performances, clever writing, and the ability to connect on a deeply human level. Candice’s charm, timing, and stage presence transform every performance into a memorable experience, leaving audiences laughing, moved, and inspired. For producers, event planners, and entertainment bookers, Italian Bred represents a unique opportunity to bring a world-class comedic and theatrical talent to any stage. Its cross-cultural appeal ensures broad audience engagement, while its streaming presence amplifies marketing potential and accessibility. Whether for a corporate event, festival, or special engagement, Italian Bred is a proven, hire-ready show that delivers unforgettable entertainment, universal relatability, and a celebration of family, heritage, and the shared human experience. Buy Now

items.detail: Join us at the movies! Der Golem (1920), directed by Paul Wegener and Carl Boese, is an early horror landmark of German Expressionism. In 16th-century Prague, Rabbi Löw shapes a man of clay to protect the Jewish ghetto from a hostile emperor. Awakened by a demon and a mystical amulet, the Golem is first a protector, then a force of ruin once others bend him to their own ends. Formed in Chicago in July 1999, Yakuza has spent a quarter century between metal and the avant-garde, with seven releases including Way of the Dead, Of Seismic Consequence and Sutra (Svart Records, 2023). On January 25, 2025, Chicago metal and experimental band Yakuza premiered their first-ever film score, performed live to the film at Thalia Hall. The night was part of WBEZ’s ongoing series in which artists choose a public domain film and write an original score for it, and it marked the band’s 25th anniversary. The movie combines the silent film and the band’s performance that night to give a very unique presentation. There will be a Q&A opportunity after the film. Buy Now

items.detail: Heralded as a mix of circus cabaret and theatre, The Vampire Circus is a mysterious, tantalizing, fun, dark, cutting-edge production guaranteed to amaze the senses. The Vampire Circus has been called a mix of circus cabaret and theater and is the result of a fusion of Tim Burton and Cirque Du Soleil. Enjoy a phenomenal night of live entertainment, based on the multidisciplinary skills of international performers showcasing theater, dance, and gymnastics. This amazing show pushes the physical boundaries of human performance and leaves audiences amazed, astounded, and astonished. Mortal spectators will experience horrific feats of Cirque acrobatics, comical audience interactions, contortionists, jugglers, acrobats, and clowns. Tantalizing sounds, and mesmerizing illusions catapult audiences into an emotional roller-coaster of fear and joy, laugher, and wonder with raving cheers for a “Mad Graveyard Clown.” The 90-minute production is an immersive ride through the Underworld and Vampires. The Vampire Circus was inspired by the magical, captivating allure of legendary traveling carnivals — and a vision of Francisco Santos, CEO founder and Cirque Du Soleil veteran performer. Set in Bohemia during the 19th century, Count Dracula contemplates a plan for world domination, when he decides to open a traveling circus with his gypsy bodyguards. The Vampire Circus is a perfect cover-up to travel unnoticed and begin his world reign of terror and turn all humans into an army of vampires for global dominance. The Vampire Circus is a journey that takes audiences into an immersive experience, plunging guests into a deep hypnotic state while “breaking the fourth wall.” With Vampire Circus, audiences are fully integrated into what is happening in front of them, surrounding them, and at times “inside” of them. The Vampire Circus will delight the senses and deliver the unexpected. As the moon comes out, the magical mystique of the Vampire World begins. Come meet the Vampires. We will leave the lights off for you!! Buy Now

items.detail: In a career spanning over 50 years, Engelbert has generated sales in excess of 140 million records, including 64 gold albums and 35 platinum, four Grammy nominations, a Golden Globe, and stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Las Vegas Walk of Fame, and Leicester Walk of Fame. He has performed for the Queen four times, several presidents and many heads of state. He has recorded everything from the most romantic ballads to movie theme songs, disco, rock, and even gospel. His unique voice has charmed millions of fans around the globe. However, it’s not just the voice, but the man himself, with his endearing sense of humor and self-deprecating jokes. Engelbert has managed to strike a new chord with the younger generation, and his YouTube music videos & social media numbers are incredible. Engelbert exploded on to the music scene with The Beatles and the Rolling Stones. The shy handsome man catapulted almost instantly to world icon. He became great friends with Elvis and the two legends often performed each other’s songs. His first single in the charts was “Release Me,” which went into the Guinness Book of Records for achieving 56 consecutive weeks on the charts. It was No. 1 in 11 countries. Engelbert’s hit song “A Man Without Love” was featured in Marvel’s “Moon Knight” Disney+ Series. In Sony Pictures’ new Brad Pitt film “Bullet Train” Engelbert’s song “Forever Blowing Bubbles” is featured. And in Netflix’s ‘Umbrella Academy” his “Quando, Quando, Quando” is heard. Buy Now

items.detail: Jason Bonham always finds himself at home behind the drumkit. From this spot, he has anchored the tempo for a myriad of the most legendary artists of all-time. It’s the place where he initially realized his destiny as a kid. It’s a tried-and-true safe harbor for the expression of his purest emotions. It’s a direct conduit to his late father and Led Zeppelin drummer John Bonham. Following stints with Airrace and Virginia Wolf, he handled drums on Jimmy Page’s gold-certified Outrider. During 1988, he notably accompanied Page, John Paul Jones, and Robert Plant behind the kit for Led Zeppelin at the Atlantic Records 40th Anniversary Celebration Concert. Beyond helming solo projects such as Bonham and The Jason Bonham Band, he appeared in Rock Star with Mark Wahlberg and Jennifer Anniston. Plus, he lent his talents to Foreigner, Little Steven, Joe Bonamassa, and Paul Rodgers. He held down the drums for Led Zeppelin’s 2007 reunion at the Ahmet Ertegun Tribute Concert—which set the Guinness World Record® for “Highest Demand for Tickets for One Music Concert.” The evening spawned the Celebration Day concert film and multiplatinum album, debuting Top 10 on the Billboard 200, selling three million-plus copies, and garnering a GRAMMY®. Other notable projects have included Black Country Communion (Bonamassa, Glenn Hughes, and Derek Sherinian) and California Breed (Hughes and producer and guitarist Andrew Watt). He joined Sammy Hagar and the Circle with Van Halen’s Michael Anthony and Joe Satriani. In 2010, he introduced Jason Bonham’s Led Zeppelin Evening (JBLZE), packing venues coast-to-coast and supporting everyone from Heart to Kid Rock. A spectacle of top-flight musicianship, arresting visuals, mind-blowing lighting, and emotionally charged storytelling, Rolling Stone hailed its “set of Led Zep gems that were strikingly faithful to the originals,” while Billy Joel handpicked JBLZE to open up a handful of dates. Ultimately, Jason remains forever at home on the drums. Buy Now
items.title: JASON BONHAM'S LED ZEPPELIN EVENING

items.detail: GCS brings together three of the most electrifying musicians in modern music: two time Grammy nominated guitarist and vocalist Eric Gales, Modern Drummer Hall of Fame drummer Dennis Chambers, and five time Best Rock Bass Player Billy Sheehan. Each of these musicians has spent decades performing at the highest levels of blues, rock, funk, jazz fusion, soul, and progressive music. Together, they form a rare lineup where every player can lead, listen, and push the music into new territory. The sound of GCS won’t be confined to one category. It will draw from the full range of their musical lives, moving from heavy blues and hard rock to deep funk, soul, and jazz fusion, with room for fearless improvisation and the kind of live interplay that only players of this caliber can deliver. Three legends, three unmistakable musical forces, one stage. When GCS comes to your city, be there to witness what happens when three titans finally join forces. Buy Now Eric Gales: Two time Grammy nominated guitarist, vocalist, and songwriter whose explosive playing has made him one of the most respected artists in modern blues and rock. The Memphis native signed with Elektra Records at 15 and released his debut album at 16, earning Best New Talent honors in Guitar World’s 1991 readers poll. His unmistakable approach, playing a right handed guitar flipped upside down, is matched by a sound that moves naturally through blues, rock, funk, soul, and psychedelia. Across more than three decades, Gales has performed or recorded with artists including Carlos Santana, Buddy Guy, Joe Bonamassa, Gary Clark Jr., Lauryn Hill, and Christone “Kingfish” Ingram. His albums The Bookends and Crown reached No. 1 on Billboard’s Blues Albums chart, while Crown and A Tribute to LJK each earned Grammy nominations for Best Contemporary Blues Album. A three time Blues Music Award winner, Gales also contributed electric guitar to Ludwig Göransson’s Grammy and Academy Award winning score for Sinners. Dennis Chambers: One of the most influential drummers of the modern era, celebrated for his deep pocket, remarkable speed, and ability to make highly technical playing feel completely musical. A self-taught prodigy from Baltimore, Chambers began playing drums at four, was performing in clubs by six, and joined Parliament/Funkadelic at 18. That early foundation in funk became part of a musical language that would eventually reach across jazz, rock, fusion, soul, and Latin music. Dennis has recorded and performed with Carlos Santana, John Scofield, John McLaughlin, George Duke, the Brecker Brothers, Maceo Parker, Mike Stern, and many others. His career also includes playing in the jazz fusion trio Niacin with Billy Sheehan and keyboardist John Novello. Dennis was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2001. Over his career he has become one of those rare drummers who can hold down an undeniable groove, drive a band with tremendous power, and take the music completely outside without ever losing its center. Billy Sheehan: one of rock’s most original and influential bassists, known for turning the instrument into both a powerful rhythmic foundation and a commanding lead voice. After building his reputation with the Buffalo power trio Talas, Sheehan joined David Lee Roth’s band alongside Steve Vai and Gregg Bissonette, recording the platinum selling albums Eat ’Em and Smile and Skyscraper. He later co founded Mr. Big, whose worldwide hit “To Be with You” reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped charts around the world. Sheehan’s career also includes extensive work with Steve Vai, The Winery Dogs, Sons of Apollo, and Niacin with Dennis Chambers and John Novello. His signature style blends deep groove with three finger picking, chords, harmonics, two handed tapping, and controlled feedback. Voted Best Rock Bass Player five times in Guitar Player’s readers poll, Sheehan earned a place in the magazine’s Gallery of Greats.

items.detail: John will be performing his catalogue of hits from his 40-year career as a solo artist, with The Baby’s and Bad English. items.detail: Art Garfunkel is known and celebrated as the “Voice of Generations” in entertainment history. He is an 8x Grammy Award winner including the Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award. In addition, he is a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee and Rolling Stone Magazine names him one of 100 Greatest Singers of All Time. As architect and lead singer of Simon & Garfunkel, he shaped modern popular culture with songs such as “Bridge Over Troubled Water,” “The Sound of Silence,” and “Mrs. Robinson.” His voice defines eras and continues to influence artists and audiences worldwide. Beyond his work leading S & G, Art Garfunkel enjoys a distinguished solo career and a notable body of work as an author, actor, and poet. As a solo artist, he has released a series of acclaimed albums, including Angel Clare, Breakaway, and Watermark, earning chart success and critical recognition for his interpretive depth and signature vocal style. His solo recordings produced enduring favorites such as I Only Have Eyes for You, (What a) Wonderful World, All I Know, and Bright Eyes, the latter becoming an international number one. In 2026, Garfunkel returns to live performances with his new world tour, Art Garfunkel in (What a) Wonderful World, featuring his legendary band. With (What a) Wonderful World, Art Garfunkel returns to the stage with a body of work that continues to speak to resilience, beauty, and shared humanity. Buy Now
